method: Quarterly temperature additive delta and precipitation multiplicative ratio applied to PRISM. PCA-whitened Mahalanobis distance using 20 annual regional PRISM vectors, converted to one-dimensional sigma. Standardized Euclidean baseline also provided.
spatial_support: Palouse regional mean vs sampled native PRISM cells on a sparse 20-km search grid. Not field-level matching.
limitations: Exploratory single-model ranking, not validated advice. Reference is 1995–2014, not current live climate. No soil, agricultural-land, irrigation, or crop filter. Quarter means omit extremes. Model tas and PRISM tmean definitions differ. No ensemble confidence or backtest yet.
